proprioceptive sensing modalities, such as audio, can be used to self supervise learning of exteroceptive sensing modalities for terrain classification in a fully unsupervised manner.

we can learn to recognize and label terrains from audio clips of vehicle terrain interaction sounds without any manual labeling effort, which can be used to train exteroceptive terrain classifiers in a self supervised manner.
